question: The only Sugar normaly absorbed in the intestine against a concentration gradient is :

CHAIN: "Mannose" -> "passive diffusion" -> "along concentration gradient" -> "no active transport" -> 60%

analysis: Glucose is the only sugar that is normally absorbed in the intestine against a concentration gradient. This process is facilitated by the sodium-glucose transport protein (SGLT1) in the intestinal epithelial cells, which uses the energy from the sodium gradient to transport glucose into the cells.
